# vaultwarden_organization_collection (List Resource)

Lists the collections of an organization, sorted by name. The provider user must be a confirmed owner or admin of the organization, or a manager with access to all collections, because collection names are encrypted with the organization key.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the collections of an organization, and generate import blocks with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "all" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
  }
}

# Only collections whose name contains "engineering", ignoring case
list "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "engineering" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
    name_contains   = "engineering"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization to list the collections of

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the collections whose name contains this text, ignoring case
